subtitle: The blueprint vs. what gets built from it

DATA
  The actual records: "Acme Corp", "Maria Gomez",

METADATA
  The blueprint: the Industry field's picklist values,
  the Account page layout, a validation rule,
  a Flow that posts to Slack when a deal closes
caption: Metadata is the blueprint. Data is what gets built from the blueprint.
